description: This file defines the BuzzPhotoDecorator class, which is part of the decorator pattern implementation for BuzzPhoto objects in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to access and process photo data within the application.

classes.name: BuzzPhotoDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for BuzzPhoto entities, providing additional methods to access photo data, including handling resource streams and string representations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the decorator with a BuzzPhoto object.

methods.name: getBuzzPhoto
methods.description: Protected method to access the underlying BuzzPhoto object.

methods.name: getPhoto
methods.description: Retrieves the photo data as a string, converting from resource if necessary.
